assumptions.description: Historic approximate bowl envelope is used provisionally for the post-renovation bowl; not a current survey.
Eighty visual row bands, uniform interpolated bowl profiles, aisle gaps, seat spacing and the inner seating boundary are estimates. Instance count is not stadium capacity.
An ellipse interpolates the stated maximum field extents. The smaller reported width has no known station and is retained as context, not forced into an invented plan.

Tower footprint, façade, balcony depths and individual floor heights are estimates. Seven level identities come from the official layouts. Overall top uses the guide height with an ambiguous top endpoint.
Arch count and cauldron reference height are source-reported; arch sizes, wall curvature, terrace, pedestal and cauldron form are estimates.
Surrounding street reference is modeled level. Landscape, circulation connections and structural shell are schematic; full under-stand interiors and surveyed walkways are absent.
West display face dimensions are source-reported; screen position, frame and supports are estimates.
Football layout and decorative markings are simplified. No LA28 temporary athletics overlay is inferred.

MVP 0.2 adds schematic exterior approach paths, plazas, drives, bowl aisle treads and stair connections to improve exploration. Locations and stair details are unverified; these are not a real-world route inventory.
